title: 第1771章 一掌拍爆龙族大殿第1770章 反向打劫一掌扇飞
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
盆地边缘的岩壁上，碎石簌簌滚落。
“咳……咳咳！”
一阵剧烈的咳嗽声打破了凝滞的空气。
李棠华佝偻着身躯，艰难地从人形深坑里爬了出来。
这位先前还高高在上、倚老卖老的曜源境六层女长老，此刻看起来凄惨到了极点。
她的左脸完全凹陷，颧骨粉碎，披头散发间满是混杂着泥土的浓稠鲜血。
“小畜生……你竟敢暗算老身！”
李棠华仅剩的一只独眼怨毒地盯着巨石上的苏铭，漏风的嘴里发出犹如夜枭般的凄厉嘶吼。
活了上百年，她怎么可能承认自己正面被一个星源境的晚辈一招秒杀。
在她看来，苏铭肯定是趁她没有防备，动用了某种威力巨大的长辈赐下的护身秘宝。
这是奇耻大辱！
“老身要将你抽筋扒皮，点天灯！”
李棠华气急败坏到了癫狂的程度。
她毫不犹豫地咬破舌尖，直接燃烧了丹田内的本源精血。
轰！
曜源境六层的狂暴罡气呈现出一种诡异的暗红色，将李棠华干瘪的身躯托举而起。
她手中的龙头拐杖化作一条咆哮的黑鳞恶蛟，张开血盆大口，带着撕裂虚空的音啸，疯狂地朝着苏铭扑杀过去。
这一击，倾注了她毕生的修为，足以将一座小山头夷为平地。
面对这来势汹汹的绝杀一击。
苏铭站在巨石上，连脚步都没有挪动半分。

“刚突破星源境三层，你这点力道，连给我松骨都不配。”
苏铭轻嗤一声，这种气血枯竭的曜源境，他从头到尾就没有放在眼里。
只见到他化自在法顺着经脉流转周身。
古铜色的右臂抬起，暗金色的龙鳞虚影在掌心汇聚，化作一只宛如实质般的遮天大手。
没有动用任何武技，就是简简单单的正面一拍。
砰！
暗金色的大手就像是拍苍蝇一般，狠狠盖在那条黑鳞恶蛟的头顶。
伴随着一声悲鸣，龙头拐杖幻化出的异象瞬间溃散，整根精铁打造的法宝拐杖寸寸崩裂。
暗金色大手去势不减，摧枯拉朽般拍在李棠华的头顶。
咔嚓！咔嚓！
清脆的骨裂声犹如爆竹般密集响起。
李棠华甚至连第二声惨叫都没能发出来，整个人就被这股泰山压顶般的巨力硬生生拍进了泥土里。
地面剧烈震颤，蛛网般的裂纹向四周蔓延出数十丈远。
烟尘散去。
李棠华像一条死狗般趴在大坑中央，浑身上下的骨骼已经碎成了粉末，只有进的气没有出的气，如同烂泥一般瘫软在地。
这一次，再也没有人觉得这是意外或者偷袭了。
content_en:
On the rock wall at the edge of the basin, gravel rolled down.
"Cough...cough!"
A violent cough broke the stagnant air.
Li Tanghua hunched his body and climbed out of the human-shaped pit with difficulty.
This sixth-level female elder of the Yaoyuan Realm, who had previously been aloof and reliant on her elders, now looked extremely miserable.
The left side of her face was completely sunken, her cheekbones were shattered, and her disheveled hair was covered with thick blood mixed with soil.
"You little beast... how dare you plot against me!"
Li Tanghua's remaining one eye stared resentfully at Su Ming on the boulder, and from his leaky mouth he roared like a night owl.
After living for hundreds of years, how could she admit that she was killed in one move by a junior from the Star Source Realm?
In her opinion, Su Ming must have taken advantage of her unpreparedness and used some kind of powerful secret treasure given to her by her elders.
What a disgrace!
"I want to peel off your cramps and skin, and light a sky lantern!"
Li Tanghua was so angry that he went crazy.
She bit the tip of her tongue without hesitation, directly burning the original essence and blood in her dantian.
boom!
The violent energy of the sixth level of Yaoyuan Realm showed a strange dark red color, lifting Li Tanghua's shriveled body up.
The dragon-headed crutch in her hand turned into a roaring black-scaled evil dragon. It opened its bloody mouth and charged towards Su Ming crazily with a roar that tore through the void.
This blow, which she had devoted her entire life to, was enough to level a small hill.
Faced with this menacing decisive blow.
Su Ming stood on the boulder without even moving an inch.
"You have just broken through the third level of the Star Source Realm. Your strength is not even enough to loosen my bones."
Su Ming snorted lightly, he had never paid attention to this kind of Yaoyuan state where Qi and blood were exhausted from the beginning to the end.
I can only see his transformation of freedom flowing along the meridians all over the body.
He raised his bronze right arm, and the shadows of dark golden dragon scales gathered in his palm, turning into a big hand that covered the sky like a substance.
He didn't use any martial arts, just a simple frontal shot.
Bang!
The big dark golden hand was like swatting a fly, covering the head of the evil black-scaled dragon.
With a mournful cry, the vision transformed by the dragon-head crutch instantly collapsed, and the entire magical crutch made of fine iron broke apart inch by inch.
The dark golden hand continued unabated and slapped Li Tanghua on the head like a beast.
Click! Click!
The crisp sound of bone cracking sounded like firecrackers.
Li Tanghua couldn't even let out a second scream, and his whole body was slammed into the soil by the overwhelming force.
The ground shook violently, and spiderweb-like cracks spread dozens of feet in all directions.
The smoke cleared.
Li Tanghua was lying in the middle of the pit like a dead dog. All the bones in his body had been shattered into powder. Only the air that had come in had not come out, and he lay limp on the ground like mud.
This time, no one thought it was an accident or a sneak attack.
